business.description: Agio Paper & Industries Ltd operates a paper factory at Bilaspur which has been under suspension since 6th October 2010 due to pollution control issues. The company is exploring alternate means to restart the factory along with a new paper mill and power plant, and is also considering generation of energy from renewable resources.

plants.capacity: Plant closed since 6th October 2010; entire plant & machinery disposed of

outlook.statement: Being restricted by the Central Pollution Control Board's order the option of exploring other areas of business has always been in the mind of management till the restrictions are lifted. The company is constantly envisaging the avenues related to generation of energy from renewable resources.

The management of the company is considering various alternative business plans to utilize the remaining PPE of the company. Further, the management does not for see any impairment in the remaining PPE of the company.
The financial viability of the company is totally dependent on the ability of the company to infuse funds into the company.
